evals.prompt: Draw a cute slime monster mascot for our puzzle game as an SVG. It should look friendly and work as an app icon.
evals.expected_output: Brief + silhouette + layered SVG (kawaii-mascot or cute-monster preset), rendered preview, 7-point checklist answered, file saved.

evals.prompt: I need a JRPG-style swordswoman hero, 3/4 view, blue and white costume, in SVG for a character select screen.
evals.expected_output: jrpg-hero preset, asymmetric costume, cel shadows, eyes via symbol/use, ≤7 colors, preview + checklist, ≤3 fix rounds.

evals.prompt: Here is my existing robot character SVG (attached). It looks flat and the arms float. Can you improve it without changing the design?
evals.expected_output: Runs render+lint first, reports flags, fixes joints/overlap, adds one light direction and cel shadows, keeps silhouette and palette.
